big: A call with a strike of ₹400 on a share trading at ₹450 is worth at least ₹50 right now. A call struck at ₹600 on the same share is worth only the hope that it gets there. Moneyness tells these apart.

lines: Exercising now would give a profit. A call is in the money when the share is above the strike. At the money means the strike is about equal to the price. Out of the money means no gain now, so its premium is all time value.

h: Moneyness of a call, made up
alt: Bars of strike against share price for three calls
caps: OTM: strike above the share price.

title: Moneyness
stops: A call is ITM when the share is above the strike
An OTM option has intrinsic value
An ATM option has a strike close to the price
caps: Its premium is all time value.

q: A call has a strike of ₹400 and the share trades at ₹450. What is it?
why: ATM needs the strike near the price. It does not answer what was asked.
The share is above the strike, so exercising gives a gain.
OTM needs no gain at the current price. That does not match this case.
Expiry depends on the date, not the price. It does not fit the facts given.

q: What is the intrinsic value of that ₹400-strike call with the share at ₹450?
why: ₹450 is the share price. The details here point elsewhere.
₹400 is the strike. That does not match this case.
It is in the money, so not zero. It does not fit the facts given.
450 less 400 gives ₹50 of immediate value. This fits the facts given.

q: A call has a strike of ₹600 and the share trades at ₹500. What is its premium made of?
why: An OTM option has no intrinsic value.
There is no intrinsic value to count.
The split is not half and half.
A premium exists, so it is not nothing.

q: A call has a strike of ₹500 and the share trades at ₹500. What is it?
why: ITM needs the share above the strike.
OTM needs the share below the strike.
Strike equals the price. This fits the facts given.
It is a call, not a put. That does not match this case.

pts: ITM: exercising now gives a gain. ATM: strike ≈ price. OTM: no gain now.
OTM premium is all time value.
